name: ended-without-agent-id-is-refused-400
description: "ended": true on a stop that names no agent_id is refused with HTTP 400. A stop without an agent_id is a Claude Code session's own Stop, sent between turns, and a session between turns has not ended; only an attempt named by its agent_id can be reported ended (#525). The session holds EXCLUSIVE on notes.md first, so a backend that took the stop as a plain one would answer 200 listing it. Both backends answer in the same words.
